description: NaBaVS₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.87-3.33 Å. Ba is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine S atoms. There are a spread of Ba-S bond distances ranging from 3.19-3.46 Å. V is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four S atoms. There are two shorter (2.15 Å) and two longer (2.17 Å) V-S bond lengths. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ba, and one V atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three equivalent Ba, and one V atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ba, and one V atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one V atom.
